title: Explainer
description: The explainer video: a concept, a process, a comparison or a piece of data made visual in 30 seconds to 3 minutes, narrated or text-led. Covers the one-question test, six shapes (how it works, why it matters, this vs that, by the numbers, listicle, story), a thesis and idea spine, one idea per scene with a named clarity device, reveal on the VO cue, the whiteboard scene grammar and board erase, VO word budgets and VO six frames after each cut, beat sheets for 30, 45, 60, 90 and 180 seconds, and data-viz rules. Load it to explain, teach, break down or visualise something rather than sell it.
summary: A concept, process, comparison or number made visual in 30 s to 3 min: one idea per scene, revealed on the VO cue.

requires.why: Facts behind the explanation, with a source for every number.
Narration, when the explainer is narrated.
Word timings of the VO, so each diagram part appears on its spoken cue.
A sparse bed under the VO and a button under the answer.
Each device has to read without the narration.

route.deliverable: A 30 second to 3 minute video that answers one question about a concept, process, comparison or number
askFirst: What question should the viewer be able to answer afterwards?
Who is it for, and how much do they already know?

triggers: explain how our sync engine works
make a video explaining this concept
visualise this data as a video
an educational video about how vaccines work
break down this process step by step
why does this matter, in a short animated video
